name: Salsa (Fresh)
siboNotes: Traditional fresh salsa typically contains onion and garlic, making it high in fructans. Use sparingly and consider making FODMAP-friendly versions.
preparationTips: Make your own salsa using green tops of scallions instead of onions
Use garlic-infused oil instead of fresh garlic
Check ingredient labels on store-bought versions for onion/garlic powder
Add fresh herbs like cilantro and parsley for extra flavor without FODMAPs
alternatives: Salsa verde made with low-FODMAP herbs
